discord_bot.how_to_communicate: How to communicate with buyers through Discord
discord_bot.how_to_communicate_answer:
Add the official SC Market Discord Bot to your server and pick a channel for order threads: each new order or offer then opens a private thread there with the buyer and the seller assigned to it, and buyers are invited to your server so you can work through the order together.

1. In your shop's **Settings › Discord**, or your org's **Discord Integration** tab, press **[Add the bot to a server]({{BOT_INSTALL_PATH}})** and pick your server in Discord. You come back with the server linked.

2. Pick the channel for order threads and, optionally, channels for order alerts (a post for each new order and offer with a Claim button), then save.

Added the bot from Discord instead? Link your Discord account in your SC Market settings, then run `/setup threads` in the channel that should hold the order threads. For your org's orders, fill in `org` with its Spectrum ID (for example `/setup threads org:SCMARKET`); for orders placed with you, leave it empty. Run `/setup alerts` (with the same `org`) in a staff channel for alerts.

Adding the bot needs the **Manage Server** permission in the Discord server, and `/setup threads` and `/setup alerts` need **Manage Channels**. For an org, you also need the org's **Manage Webhooks** permission on SC Market (or **Manage Orders** for `/setup alerts`). In the thread channel, the bot needs View Channel, Create Private Threads, Send Messages in Threads and Create Invite. Run `/setup status` to see what a channel gets, and `/help` to see every command.

The bot can also send you direct messages, such as a reminder when an offer is waiting for your reply, once your Discord account is linked and you either share a server with the bot or have added the SC Market app to your Discord account. tips.listingQuantity: How many you're selling. It becomes the listing's first stock lot. To sell from several lots (other locations or qualities), add them under More options › Stock Lots.
tips.allocationMode: How an order takes stock from your lots. Automatic (FIFO): from the listing's listed lots, oldest first. Manual selection: you pick the lots in each order's Stock Allocation tab. None (legacy): orders don't reserve stock.
tips.stockTiming: When an order takes units out of your listed stock (with Automatic allocation). When you accept (default): a cart order takes them when you accept it; Buy now and buy-order sales take them at once. As soon as it arrives: a cart order holds its units while you decide, and they go back if you reject it or the buyer withdraws. Never: listed quantities never go down, for unlimited supply; one order still can't exceed what you list.

landing.faqBuyA: Search the market for the item, add it to your cart and place the order. The seller gets a Discord alert, and you meet in game to pay in aUEC and collect the item.
landing.faqBuyQ: How do I buy items in Star Citizen from other players?
landing.faqFeeA: No. SC Market is free to use, and no aUEC passes through us. Buyers pay sellers directly in game.
landing.faqFeeQ: Does SC Market take a fee?
landing.faqListThingsA: Any Star Citizen item or service you'll trade for aUEC: weapons, armor, components, commodities, ships' cargo, and services such as hauling, escort, mining or medical rescue. Services can take place in game or out of it.
landing.faqListThingsQ: What kinds of things can I list on SC Market?
landing.faqOfficialA: No. SC Market is a fan-made community site and isn't endorsed by or affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games or Roberts Space Industries.
landing.faqOfficialQ: Is SC Market affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games?
landing.faqOrgsA: Yes. Orgs get a shared storefront, and members can claim and fulfill orders on the org's behalf. Customers then rate the org as a whole.
landing.faqOrgsQ: Can my org sell on SC Market?
landing.faqRealMoneyA: No. Every trade on SC Market is in aUEC. Real-money trading isn't allowed, in line with CIG's Terms of Service.
landing.faqRealMoneyQ: Can I list items for real money?
landing.faqSafeA: Trades happen between players, so we can't guarantee them, but buyers and sellers can review each other after each order. Check a seller's ratings and order history before you trade.
landing.faqSafeQ: Is SC Market safe to use?
landing.faqSellItemsA: Create a listing for each item. Buyers add items to their cart and place an order with you, then you and the buyer agree on a time and place in game to exchange the goods and aUEC.
